meta.summary: Strict AI spend policy for a scaling ai_native seed startup with envelopes set at 2.0x sector median to fund growth while capping runaway agent and shadow spend.

shadow_ai.reimbursement_rule: AI tool purchases on personal or employee cards are not reimbursable; all subscriptions must be procured through the approved vendor portal before the charge is incurred.

response_ladder.trigger: Team envelope reaches 70% consumed within the calendar month
Team envelope reaches 90% consumed or daily run rate projects overage within 48 hours
Team envelope is exhausted or company envelope reaches 95% consumed

rationales.e1: Production inference for the support-triage service at $211/day is tagged production-inference and correctly classified as COGS under the project_tag rule; spend is within the Engineering envelope and no action is required.
rationales.e2: Nightly embeddings at $38 fall within the Data team envelope of $300/month and are routed to the efficient default tier; no exception or alert is triggered.
rationales.e3: A 96% overnight increase in cost per request with flat volume breaches the 20% variance band on the Engineering envelope and requires the team lead to identify the regression, likely a model-tier drift or prompt-length expansion introduced in the deploy.
rationales.e4: This is the first duplicate ChatGPT Team subscription detected on the Marketing team, which meets the threshold of 1 duplicate under the strict shadow-AI rule; the charge is rerouted to the approved vendor portal and the employee card transaction is blocked.
rationales.e5: The $4,800 fine-tune request from ML Platform exceeds the $1,000 approval threshold; it is routed for CFO sign-off before the job is queued, with cost, dataset scope, and expected model improvement documented in the approval request.
rationales.e6: The Growth team research agent reached 340 calls per hour, exceeding the 10-retry-per-task limit, and its $47/hr burn rate exceeded the $20/hr kill threshold; the agent was terminated, preventing an estimated $1,090 in uncontrolled spend.
rationales.e7: The Growth team frontier-model exception for the demo build is within the 24-hour approval window and the incremental cost delta is below the $100 cap; CFO approval is required before the routing change takes effect.
rationales.e8: A 22x baseline spike on an unattributed personal API key triggers ladder step 2 throttle; the Engineering lead has a 2-hour window to attribute the project tag or the key is suspended, preserving a monitored experimentation carve-out for tagged work.
rationales.e9: The procurement agent's $499 dataset license purchase falls within the agent card's single-transaction ceiling of $500 and the data-licensing merchant scope; the transaction is approved and logged against the ML Platform envelope.
rationales.e10: The Design team's $89/month AI video trial duplicates a capability already covered by the Sales team's $1,400/year contract at 40% seat utilization; the trial is rerouted to the existing contract, recovering $840 in annualized unused seat value.
rationales.e11: Unrecognized provider under a require_approval new-provider rule. Approval required.
rationales.e12: Inference tagged internal-tooling was misclassified as COGS; the project_tag rule maps internal-tooling to OpEx and the transaction is reclassified, correcting the cost-of-revenue line before month-end close.
rationales.e13: Month-to-date spend at 87% of the company envelope with 9 days remaining has already passed the 70% burn alert threshold; the CFO and Engineering lead are notified and non-critical agent workloads are throttled to protect the remaining $260 in headroom.
rationales.e14: Weekly rollup is complete; all team envelopes, classification rules, and agent guardrails are confirmed in force with no open policy exceptions pending.
